articleTitle: Intelligent campus access management system using facial recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: In recent years, campus security has been gradually raised to a new height, and the requirements for intelligent campus have been gradually improved. In terms of school security control, the facial recognition management system based on deep learning has gradually replaced the traditional authentication system based on smart card and fingerprint recognition. Herein, we designed an intelligent campus system based on facial recognition and temperature measurement for further applying the facial recognition technology to an intelligent campus management system. The system realizes the convenience and non-replicability of face recognition system. Combined with the real-time body temperature status of each passing person, to effectively manage the access of students, teachers and visitors to the campus to ensure the safety and health of the campus.

articleTitle: Synthesizing Virtual Chinese Palace Scenes on OpenStreetMap
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: As multicultural environments are gaining popularity among people from all over the world who have different cultural backgrounds, historical and regional digital virtual environments authoring become a hot topic in the game, movie, and other multimedia industries. As one genre of multicultural multimedia, virtual Chinese palace scenes serve as a popular theme in Chinese 3D video games or 3D animations. However, manually designing the virtual Chinese palace scenes demands lots of effort from the game designers. In this paper, we propose a novel technical approach to automatically synthesize the virtual Chinese palace scenes on OpenStreetMap without demanding manual efforts. Our procedural modeling approach is able to convert any given modern urban architecture in the real world into a virtual Chinese palace architecture with a similar shape that results in a similar urban layout. In the experiment results, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in synthesizing virtual Chinese palace scenes in different real-world locations.

articleTitle: The Identification of Device Status Indicator in Hydropower Station Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: In order to timely detect abnormal status indicators of hydropower stations when no one is on duty, it becomes very important to develop a real-time detection system for achieving remote alarms. To achieve this goal, this paper studies the detection and identification of facility status indicators by utilizing the surveillance camera in hydropower station. We firstly collect many camera based images from various station indicators and construct the training datasets. Then we choose to use the lightweight YOLOv5s model for detecting images captured by the camera. Finally, the detection effectiveness is evaluated by the average accuracy. The test results show that the model can effectively identify changes of device status indicators in hydropower station.

articleTitle: Superquadric Modeling Method of 3D Object Based on Invasive Weeds Optimization and Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Because of the problem of insufficient parameter fitting accuracy of superquadric modeling method based on Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm, a superquadric modeling method of 3D object based on invasive weed optimization (IWO) algorithm and LM algorithm is proposed. First, according to the distance relationship between each point in point cloud and the superquadric, a nonlinear optimization model for superquadric parameter estimation of 3D object is established. Then, to obtain the initial values of superquadric fitting parameters, the IWO algorithm is adopted to optimize the optimization model. After that, LM algorithm is also adopted to optimize the optimization model, and estimation values of superquadric fitting parameters of 3D object can be obtained. Thus, the superquadric model of 3D object of the given point cloud can be established. The experimental results show that the proposed method can yield highly accurate superquadric fitting parameters, and can effectively suppress the influence of measurement noise on modeling accuracy as well.

articleTitle: Video Coding Scheme Using Pre-Processing Degradation and Post-Processing Restoration
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Extending coding tools beyond but compatible to video coding standards provides a new path to higher coding efficiency. In this paper, we propose an efficient video coding scheme with pre-processing degradation and post-processing restoration. Proper amount of high frequency information is removed before encoding using edge-preserving filter, while the post-processing module exploiting convolutional neural network (CNN) restores degraded frames due to pre-processing and coding artifacts such as quantization error. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed video coding scheme achieves coding efficiency gain of up to - 9.6% Bjontegaard delta bit rate (BDBR) compared with H.265/HEVC reference model.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of the Gamma Knife Source Change Process Based on Spatial Radiation Dose Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of inefficiency, poor economy and low safety of manual-based Gamma Knife radiation source change work, the use of robots to replace manual source change has become an important development trend. To achieve an automated source change, it is necessary to design source shielding devices with excellent weight and shielding performance, as well as a highly reliable source change workflow. In this paper, the spatial dose distribution after source shielding and protection during source change is modelled and analysed, and the source shielding device is designed, as well as the process for robots to complete the source change operation. The stability and rationality of the source change workflow are verified by simulation experiments. With the designed shielding device, the maximum leakage of the spatial radiation dose distribution is 8 mGy/h, and the robot can work stably and complete the source change operation several times.

articleTitle: Channel and Spatial Transformer for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Underwater images always suffered from significant degradation, such as color deviation, low contrast and blurred details. Underwater image enhancement is an essential step to improve the image quality. However, the existing underwater image enhancement results always have the problem of colour bias, and do not consider the non-uniform attenuation in different color channels. In this paper, a channel and spatial (CS) transformer module is proposed for the underwater image enhancement, where multi-dimensional attention is extracted from the deep features. The channel-level multiscale feature fusion (CMFT) module focuses on the channel with severe color attenuation. The spatial-level attention module(SAT) focuses on the degraded regions in spatial domain. Furthermore, a new loss function that combines perceptual losses in RGB, LAB and LCH colour spaces is proposed to correct color distoration and improve image details. A large number of experiments on existing datasets have verified the excellent performance of the proposed networks.

articleTitle: Manifold Proximal Gradient with Momentum for Sparse PCA
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Sparse principal component analysis (SPCA) aims to find sparse loading vectors for dimension reduction in finance, biology, image/signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we propose a manifold proximal gradient with momentum method for SPCA. We introduce selection strategy to obtain better iteration points and apply the adaptive momentum method to reduce the number of iterations. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method can get better results for some test data.

articleTitle: ACE-HF Framework: Enhancing Implicit Information in Hyperspectral Lacquer Coffin Paintings through Automatic Color Enhancement and Homomorphic Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Hyperspectral lacquer coffin painting is an important cultural heritage in China. However, distinguishing polluted areas in visible light is challenging in the visible light due to the influence of pollutants. Hyperspectral imaging, obtained by imaging in tens to hundreds of continuous and finely divided spectral bands, can extract image information beyond the visible light range more easily. Therefore, using hyperspectral data, this paper proposes a method for enhancing implicit information in hyperspectral lacquer Coffin painting based on automatic color enhancement and homomorphic filtering (ACE-HF) framework, which combines histogram matching, automatic color enhancement (ACE), and homomorphic filtering. Firstly, ACEHF framework uses minimum noise fraction (MNF) denoising to obtain the information-rich near-infrared band in hyperspectral image, replacing the red band in the RGB image extracted from hyperspectral data to synthesize a pseudo-color image. Secondly, the pseudo-color image is matched with the true color image by histogram matching to maintain the color fidelity of the original image. Then, ACE-HF framework then uses an improved “decomposition-composition” ACE algorithm to enhance the image details of the stained area while reducing the computational complexity. Finally, homomorphic filtering is introduced to further separate noise information and improve the image quality of the lacquer Coffin painting. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed ACE-HF framework method can extract and enhance the pattern information in the polluted areas of lacquer Coffin painting and has the potential to be applied to other contaminated cultural heritage images for implicit information extraction and blurred cultural heritage images for detail enhancement.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Generation and Discrimination for Sketch Extraction of Painted Cultural Relics
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Sketches of painted cultural relics can accurately represent the main content and outline structure of painted images, providing convenience for researchers studying ancient culture and the painting styles of artists. Most existing sketch extraction methods rely on edge detection technology, which may result in incomplete details, blurring, and artifacts. Additionally, for severely damaged murals, these methods may not yield ideal extraction results. In recent years, generative adversarial networks have made remarkable progress in image processing. Cycle-consistent generative adversarial networks, in particular, provide a new approach for the extraction of painted cultural relics. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-scale generation and discrimination method for the extraction of painted cultural relics based on cycle-consistent generative adversarial networks. The method utilizes multi-scale gradient technology, allowing the discriminator to view the multi-scale output of the generator. Furthermore, a feature fusion optimization module replaces the traditional skip connection to achieve multi-scale feature fusion. Additionally, an attention residual module is designed to retain the original features, strengthen the constraints on the features of the sketch, and reduce the influence of background noise on the generated results. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with existing methods, this approach yields higher-quality sketches and performs better in objective indicators.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Media Art in Museum Exhibition -- Take Nanjing City Wall Museum as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Digital media art is increasingly utilised in contemporary museums. As a museum with collection, research, education, and communication functions, it can use new media communication methods such as film and television broadcasting, three-dimensional animation restoration, and interactive game design to clarify the complex historical background, analyse the multi-dimensional architectural structure, and restore the production and use of cultural relics, thereby improving the efficiency of information transmission. It has a crucial function in establishing the contact between cultural artefacts and people, and in enhancing the enjoyment of the audience. This paper uses the Nanjing City Wall Museum as an example, divides the digital media art used in the museum into three categories of animation, video recording, digital interaction, and two-dimensional animation, analyses the digital display methods applicable to different categories of cultural relics based on specific cases, and concludes with ideas for the application of new media digital art in museum exhibition design. To achieve complete transmission of cultural legacy, social value must be emphasised.

articleTitle: Adversarial Attacks Based on Feature Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Deep learning models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. The existence of adversarial examples poses a significant threat to the security of deep learning models. However, most existing adversarial attacks are supervised methods that rely on labels, limiting the transferability of adversarial examples between different task models. In contrast, SSP, a self-supervised method for generating adversarial examples, was introduced at the top computer vision conference, CVPR, and is independent of the task and label space. However, experimental analysis shows that different feature layers of different models exhibit varying degrees of adversarial transferability. NRP only uses a single middle layer feature of a single pre-trained model, making it challenging to achieve optimal attack transferability across all models simultaneously. Inspired by ensemble learning, this paper proposes a feature integration strategy based on NRP to enhance the middle layer feature information, maximize the distance between adversarial and clean samples in the feature space of multiple pre-trained models, and effectively improve the blackbox transferability of adversarial samples.

articleTitle: Radar Active Jamming Signal Identification Method Based on Time-frequency Image Features
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: In this paper, the Choi-Williams method is used to describe five typical jamming signals, and the grayscale images of the time-frequency two-dimensional distribution of the jamming signals are obtained. The contour information is maximally enhanced by median filtering and image segmentation processing algorithms for the grayscale images. The effective time-frequency domain feature parameter set is extracted and the dimensionality reduction is done. SVM is used to identify typical radar active jamming signals and provide a priori information for radar anti-jamming. This paper verifies the adopted method by MATLAB simulation experiments and analyzes the performance and feasibility of the adopted method.

articleTitle: Design and in-orbit application of multi-head star sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Star sensor is a widely used astrometric sensor, which is one of the important attitude sensors in spacecraft control systems. The multi-head star senor is the first sub-arc-second star sensor in-orbit. The key design and distinct characteristic are proposed, the consistency between orbit result and ground test is analyzed based on orbit and ground data. The result in orbit show that single head precision is higher than $1''$ (30), and the fusion accuracy based on multi-head is better than $0.6 ''$ $(3\sigma)$ the optical-axis angle error is lower than $2''$, the SEA(sun excluded angle) is better than 26°. The star sensor can be used to military remote sensing satellite, astro observation with high precision and space science platform.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral image super-resolution based on recurrent dense fusion network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: With the development of optical imaging technology, more and more imaging techniques are being used in the field of cultural relics conservation and analysis. Among these, hyperspectral imaging has received much attention for its nondestructive, non-contact and ‘image-spectrum integration’ characteristics. However, due to the physical limitation of the imaging sensor, the spatial resolution of existing hyperspectral images is far less than that of RGB three-channel high-definition digital cameras, which greatly hinders the application of hyperspectral digitization of cultural relics. To address this problem, this paper proposes a hyperspectral image superresolution method based on a recurrent dense fusion network. By incorporating a fusion network with a recurrent neural network and a dense spatial-spectral attention module, the spatial and spectral features are fused. Finally, the hyperspectral image with high spatial and spectral resolution is obtained by the reconstruction module. The experimental results show that the proposed method can better improve the spatial resolution while maintaining the spectral resolution with a low number of parameters, both in terms of subjective vision and objective metrics.

articleTitle: Low-Illumination Image Enhancement Based on End-to-End Network Using Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Images are always susceptible to variations in light which makes the low-illumination image enhancement an important task. Conventional low-illumination image enhancement methods are typically implemented by improving image brightness and contrast, while suppressing image noise simultaneously. Recently, the deep learning-based methods have also been applied to image enhancement. However, the restoration of the original brightness and detailed textures in dark images remains challenging. In this paper, an end-to-end neural network is proposed. The coordinate attention (CA) module and the squeeze excitation(SE) module are introduced to refme and highlight key features. A perceptual loss function is also proposed to enhance the texture of the details and restore the visual distortion. The effectiveness of the proposed network is demonstrated in experiments on popular datasets.

articleTitle: Bronze Corrosion Identification Method Based on Hyperspectral Image Unmixing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Bronze surface patina is prone to mixed stacking and it is not easy to examine the distribution of bronze patina, making it difficult to identify harmful patina. At present, conservators mainly rely on human observation to identify patina, which relies heavily on expert experience and is not easy to record. With the development of imaging technology and deep learning, some intelligent methods have begun to be applied to bronze patina identification. However, the bronze training samples are also mainly labelled and extracted by visual observation, and the quality of the selected samples is uncertain. Therefore, this paper proposes a bronze patina identification method based on hyperspectral image unmixing. The method decomposes the overlapping spectral features based on hyperspectral image unmixing to make the extracted spectral features more representative, and combines the spectral library to not only identify specific types of patina, but also select training samples based on the abundance map to provide accurate training samples for the classification task, and improve the efficiency and accuracy of bronze surface patina labelling. The experiments show that the method has good results in the intelligent annotation of bronze corrosion categories.

articleTitle: Whole Heart Segmentation Method Based on Position Encoding Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: The heart is an important organ in the human circulatory system. In recent years, whole heart segmentation methods based on deep learning have achieved good results, but most of these algorithms fail to fully extract the global feature information of each substructure in the heart, and can not accurately segment the fuzzy boundary pixels in the heart. Aiming at the problem of whole heart segmentation, this work proposes a whole heart segmentation based on position encoding guidance. According to the particularity of the heart, this method uses the adjusted distance formula to generate the heart position information, and embeds it into the proposed network. The self-attention mechanism is introduced into the lower three layers of the network skip connection, and the internal relationships of the feature map are calculated by adding trace parameters to make full use of the features of each pixel. A multi-scale feature fusion module is introduced in the upper two layers of network skip connection to solve the problem of small receptive field of shallow feature maps. Experiments show that the proposed method has improved the segmentation efficiency of different substructure boundaries of the heart.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Algorithm Based on YOLO and Lightweight Network EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Deep learning based object detection algorithms have been applied in various fields of life. As a representative of one-stage detection algorithms, YOLO series algorithms are highly favored for their fast speed.To resolve the existing issues with complex network architecture and weak real-time performance. YOLOv3 and YOLOv4 are improved by adding the lightweight network EfficientNet, using deep separable convolution rather than regular convolution, reducing a significant number of network parameters, using transfer learning to speed up the model’s training speed, and speeding up the model’s convergence. Finally, the accuracy, number of parameters, and detection rate of the network structure before as well as after improvement are compared to ensure that the model is successful. According to the experimental findings, the number of parameters for E-YOLOv3 and E-YOLOv4 are only 1/9 and 1/7 of what they were before the enhancement, and the detection rate has increased by 4 and 3 frames/second, respectively.

articleTitle: A DC Algorithm Scheme For Generalized Eigenvalue Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Generalized eigenvalue classffiers handle the classification problem very well. However, the major disadvantages of generalized eigenvalue based method lie in that they may be time-consuming and fail to get a stable or optimal solution due to the matrix singularity. This paper proposes a new method using a DC Algorithm scheme to solve a fractional optimization models which ensure the optimality of the solution. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method can get better results for public data sets.

articleTitle: Video Summarization with Encoder-Decoder Based Graph-Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Video summarization aims to generate a brief summary containing key video information by eliminating redundant information in videos. Video summarization faces many challenges such as the high cost of video data annotation, the lack of professional datasets, and the inaccuracy of keyframes selection algorithms. To address the above issues, we propose a non-manual dataset annotation method based on the number of online video barrage, and construct a new video summarization dataset based on this method. In addition, we propose an encoder-decoder based graph-attention video summarization algorithm, which introduces a graph attention mechanism and only assigns different weights to relevant sampled frame features to improve the precision of keyframes selection. Our method achieved state-of-the-art results on both benchmark datasets (SumMe and TVsum) and our new dataset.

articleTitle: Study on Ellipse Detection Method Based on KMPE Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: For point set containing noise and outliers, the existing ellipse detection methods have low detection accuracy. Aiming at this problem, an ellipse detection method based on kernel mean p-power error (KMPE) loss function is proposed. Firstly, the point set to be detected is pre-processed according to the 3$\sigma$ criterion, and the noise points and outliers with large random errors are filtered out. Secondly, KMPE loss function is introduced, and according to distance constraint of each point on the ellipse to its focuses, a robust nonlinear optimization model of ellipse detection based on KMPE is established. Thirdly, success-history based parameter adaptation for differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm is adopted to solve the optimization model, and the initial estimated parameters of the detected ellipse is obtained. And the data points are divided into inliers and outliers according to the initial estimated parameters. Finally, the SHADE algorithm is adopted again to optimize the optimization model with inliers, and the accuracy estimated parameters of the detected ellipse can be obtained. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy of ellipse detection, and can effectively suppress the influence of noise and outliers on ellipse detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A Method for Labeling Flaking Disease on Ancient Murals Based on Gradient Trainable Gabor and Channel Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Disease labeling is usually the first step to protect and repair mural relics scientifically and effectively. The most common method for disease labeling at present is manual mapping of disease regions on orthophoto image by humancomputer interaction. However, this method is not only time consuming, but also has different labeling result due to different expert experience. Recently, with the development of artificial intelligence, machine learning and other technologies, automatic labeling can be achieved by deep learning and so on. However, due to the wide variety and varying manifestations of mural diseases, targeted research is needed on each type of disease. For typical flaking in mural relics, this paper presents a gradient trainable Gabor and channel attention convolution network (GTGCAC-Net) to extract texture information of flaking in order to label it efficiently and accurately. Gradient trainable Gabor integrates the characteristics of gradient information and Gabor filter to obtain rich edge information and texture information and other shallow features. The decoder part uses the channel attention module to establish the dependency relationship between each feature graph in the network and enhance the ability of the network to obtain remote context information. Residual skip connections are used to better integrate the texture features extracted by shallow convolution with the deeper abstract features of the encoder. Experiments on the murals of Fengguo Temple in Yi County, Jinzhou, Liaoning Province, China, show that the method proposed in this paper can achieve automatic labeling of flaking of the mural relics.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Multi-modal Knowledge Graph for Collection of Cultural Relics
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: In recent years, computer technology has advanced significantly and more and more museums have begun to prioritize digital protection of cultural relics, achieving fruitful results. However, the digital resources of these relics are often stored in document or relational database forms, and displayed on the museum website using basic division methods. Moreover, each cultural relic collection holds its own unique knowledge points and there must be rich associations between them due to certain commonalities, which cannot be fully applied by existing preservation techniques. Multi-modal Knowledge Graphs (MMKG) have undergone years of development and have achieved significant results and widespread applications. Although China has abundant multi-modal data on cultural relics, there is limited exploration of MMKG in the field of cultural relics. Therefore, this paper proposes to construct a MMKG for museum relics, RelicMMKG, to mine the information contained in the multimodal digital resources of museum relics. This includes using the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model to identify multiple types of entities in the relic text introduction and using image descriptors to extract and calculate the similarity of visual features in the relic image data. Furthermore, based on the RelicMMKG and structured text and image data, a multifunctional application system is implemented to better explore the correlation between cultural relics, enabling efficient excavation and application of cultural relics data in the museum.

articleTitle: Dual Adversarial Contrastive Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Underwater images are highly distorted, which makes high-level computer vision tasks difficult. Existing underwater image enhancement algorithms mainly focus on restoring the appearance of images. As a result, enhanced images may not be useful for high-level computer vision tasks. The lack of label images also makes most supervised learning networks impractical. In this paper, a dual adversarial contrastive learning enhancement network is proposed, which is both visually friendly and task-oriented. A circular network is proposed to achieve self-supervised learning between unpaired images. We also introduce a contrastive prior between the enhanced and degraded results in feature space to ensure the good visual appearance of the enhanced results. Furthermore, the high-level detection task is also used to constrain the enhanced results. The experiments were carried out on a popular underwater dataset, the enhanced images of the proposed method showed better visual quality and improve tracking performance as well.

articleTitle: LineSegNet: A network architecture for extracting continuous lines from complex backgrounds
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Line extraction is a key step in the analysis and identification of line chart in paper documents. However, challenges such as noise interference, line discontinuity, and complex image backgrounds often degrade the accuracy and effectiveness of line extraction tasks. In this paper, an end-to-end multi-path lightweight nebvork architecture is proposed, which called LineSegNet for Line extraction in paper documents. LineSegNet are generated in three modules: global perception module, local perception module and progressive fusion module. With these modules, the multi-layer residual structure incorporating attention mechanism and the multi convolutional kernel are integrated in a unified architecture. Global perceptual features and local perceptual features are fused in the progressive fusion module to accurately segment lines from complex backgrounds. The experimental results indicate that our method can significantly reduce hardware resources and demonstrate competitive performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic Digital Signage System: A Cost-Effective and Unified Web-Based Solution for Content and Analytics Management
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: While several content management systems (CMS) and audience analytics tools are available for digital signage in the market, they are often sold separately and can be expensive. Therefore, this project aims to design a cost-effective and unified web-based solution for digital signage that combines content management and audience analytics functions, reducing the need for multiple purchases. This can be achieved by utilizing Raspberry Pi technology, known for its cost-effectiveness and versatility in integrations, along with a face recognition camera and machine learning methods. This proof of concept demonstrates the integration of these components to create a dynamic digital signage system. Overall, this project has the potential to offer an affordable solution for companies aiming to efficiently manage and optimize their digital marketing strategies, especially in the Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) Advertising space.

articleTitle: Review of Space Dim Target Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: At present, space dim target detection is easy to be disturbed by background noise and stars, difficult detection and long capture period. How to realize accurate detection of space dim target in low SNR condition, improve target sensitivity and obtain high-precision target position information, and meet the qualification of high detection rate and low false alarm rate is the key problem of space dim target detection technology. This paper introduces the current situation of image preprocessing, single-frame and multi-frame detection methods of space target, analyzes and evaluates its advantages and disadvantages, summarizes the development direction and trend of detection technology, and provides reference and suggestions for the research of space dim target detection technology.

articleTitle: Emotion Interpretational Caption of Art Visual based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Caption generation for the emotional interpretation of art is a challenging task. The difficulty lies in the fact that the model needs to generate captions that are consistent with human cognition, through learning better the interrelations among images, emotions, and corresponding texts. However, the current emotion interpretation task follows the traditional caption model that is unable to improve objective metrics (such as BLEUI-4, CIDEr) and emotion metrics (consistency of emotion interpretation) simultaneously. It proved the model still has great potential for improvement. Therefore, this paper designs an emotion interpretational caption model based on reinforcement learning. It consists of auxiliary tasks, a traditional captioning model, and reinforcement learning, in which reinforcement learning considers the reward of emotional concepts to optimize performance, avoiding bias in the interpretation of emotional types. The framework is validated through an exhaustive analysis, both quantitative and qualitative, as well as diversity, demonstrating outstanding results in terms of both objective indicators and emotional indicators. This proved the effectiveness of reinforcement learning considering emotional concepts in improving the potential performance of the emotional interpretation captions model.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality System Based on Real-Time Object 6D Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Media Computing (ICIPMC)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) refers to the perfect integration of virtual information with the real environment through computer technology, enhancing people’s understanding of the real environment. Due to its excellent interactivity and realistic visual effects, it has received extensive attention from various fields. The effectiveness of augmented reality largely depends on whether virtual information can be accurately rendered in the real scene, with the most critical aspect being the 6D pose estimation of the target object in the real scene. Deep learning-based pose estimation methods have become indispensable technology in AR systems due to their high accuracy and wide applicability. Among existing pose estimation algorithms, YOLO6D has the advantages of good stability and fast speed. However, for AR applications that require interaction with the human eye, due to its complex network structure and large computational complexity, it still faces challenges in real-time performance and deployment on mobile devices. Therefore, this paper aims to achieve a mobile AR system based on real-time pose estimation, using the YOLO-6D pose estimation network as the foundation, and conducting research from the aspects of model compression and system design. By using model compression algorithms include channel pruning and knowledge distillation (KD), the computational and parameter complexity of the pose estimation model is reduced, and the network inference speed is improved. At the same time, the AR tasks are decomposed in the system design to alleviate the performance pressure during deployment on mobile devices, thus building a high-quality, low-latency mobile AR system.
